## BACKLOG.MD GUIDELINES (MUST FOLLOW)
Markdown version of the tasks live under **`backlog/tasks/`** (drafts under **`backlog/drafts/`**).  
Every implementation decision starts with reading the corresponding Markdown task file.  
Project documentation is in **`backlog/docs/`**. Decisions in **`backlog/decisions/`**.  
All task operations must be done via **Backlog.md CLI tool** (correctly updates metadata in task files); **NO OPERATIONS SHOULD BE DONE MANUALLY ON THE TASK FILES**.  
**Always use `--plain` flag** when listing or viewing tasks for AI-friendly text output instead of using Backlog.md.  
When users mention tasks, they probably suggest using Backlog.md CLI tool. Ask questions if unclear/ambiguous.  
Break down large/complex tasks into smaller manageable parts. Use clear brief title; concise summary (no implementation details).  
List specific measurable outcomes as checkboxes. For `## Acceptance Criteria`, focus on outcomes/behaviors/verifiable requirements (not step-by-step implementation). ACs must be testable, clear, concise, complete. Example: `- [ ] User can successfully log in with valid credentials.`

Once a task is created it will be stored as `task-<id> - <title>.md` under **`backlog/tasks/`**.  
When creating tasks: atomic, testable, single PR; dependency order (foundations before features); avoid blocking tasks; no references to future/non-created tasks; only reference tasks with `id < current task id`.

### Mandatory task sections
- **Implementation Plan**: Add only after task is put in progress and before starting work.  
- **Implementation Notes**: Added after completion; concise but informative; includes approach/decisions/challenges/deviations; must document core changes.

### Completion requirements (task is **Done** only when ALL are complete)
1. **Acceptance criteria** checklist fully checked (`- [ ]` → `- [x]`).  
2. Implementation plan followed or deviations documented in **Implementation Notes**.  
3. Automated tests (unit + integration) cover new logic.  
4. Static analysis: linter & formatter succeed.  
5. Relevant docs updated (README/backlog/docs/backlog/decisions/etc.).  
6. Review: self review code.  
7. Task hygiene: status set to **Done** via CLI (`backlog task edit <id> -s Done`).  
8. No regressions: performance, security and licence checks green.  
Also: Task file **MUST** have an `## Implementation Notes` summarizing Features implemented or modified; Technical decisions/trade-offs; Modified or added files.

### Backlog CLI commands (keep verbatim)
backlog task list -s "To Do" --plain  
backlog task 42 --plain  
backlog task edit 42 -a @{yourself} -s "In Progress"  
backlog task edit 42 --plan "1. Analyze current implementation\n2. Identify bottlenecks\n3. Refactor in phases"  
backlog task create "Refactor DB layer" -p 42 -a @{yourself} -d "Description" --ac "Tests pass,Performance improved"  
backlog task edit 42 -s Done --notes "Implemented GraphQL resolver with error handling and performance monitoring"  

| Create task | `backlog task create "Add OAuth System"` |
| --- | --- |
| Create with description | `backlog task create "Feature" -d "Add authentication system"` |
| Create with assignee | `backlog task create "Feature" -a <REDACTED_USER>` |
| Create with status | `backlog task create "Feature" -s "In Progress"` |
| Create with labels | `backlog task create "Feature" -l auth,backend` |
| Create with priority | `backlog task create "Feature" --priority high` |
| Create with plan | `backlog task create "Feature" --plan "1. Research\n2. Implement"` |
| Create with AC | `backlog task create "Feature" --ac "Must work,Must be tested"` |
| Create with notes | `backlog task create "Feature" --notes "Started initial research"` |
| Create with deps | `backlog task create "Feature" --dep task-1,task-2` |
| Create sub task | `backlog task create -p 14 "Add Login with Google"` |
